player_prompt.intro:
Uwewe ni Umukinnyi {player_id} ukina igikino ca Pig Dice.

Amateka:
- Ku gihe cy'ikibazo, ushobora '[roll]' cyangwa '[hold]'
- Kanda 2-6: Ongeza kuri turn total yawe
- Kanda 1: Upige turn total yawe na kuguma ikibazo
- Hara: Ongeza turn total yawe kuri score yawe na kuguma ikibazo
- Uwa mbere kuzamura {winning_score} pointi unatsinze

Ugiye kubona ibipimo bifite ikibazo na turn total.
Wivuge '[roll]' ukanda ikibazo cyangwa '[hold]' ukatwara pointi zawe.
